children: Floor & Decor reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of $1.21 billion, up 3% from the prior-year quarter, while net income rose 13.2% to $64.82 million and diluted EPS increased 15.1% to $0.61.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Third-quarter comparable sales declined 1.4%, while 39-week net sales increased 1.8% to $3.617 billion and comparable sales fell 2.4%. Fewer transactions outweighed higher average tickets.
Pro customers represented about 55% of retail sales, up from 50% a year earlier; homeowners made up the remaining 45%.
Floor & Decor opened 12 warehouses year to date and 20 since September 2025, bringing its footprint to 282 stores across 39 states and five design studios.
Gross margin improved to 43.7% in the quarter, partly reflecting tariff refunds recognized as the related inventory was sold.
